effect_description_eng: [On Play] [When Digivolving] You may suspend 1 Digimon. Then, if this Digimon is suspended, ＜De-Digivolve 1＞ 1 of your opponent's Digimon and, until the end of your opponent's turn, their effects can't return this Digimon to hands or decks or affect it with ＜De-Digivolve＞ effects.
inherited_effect_description_eng: [All Turns] [Once Per Turn] When this Digimon deletes your opponent's Digimon in battle, trash their top security card.
